stories.title: GDOT plans overnight lane closures on I-285 for Chattahoochee River bridge repairs
stories.summary: Crews will make a localized repair to the bridge joint using concrete, which GDOT expects to last longer than the asphalt used during a recent weekend repair.

stories.title: Cement truck crashes into pedestrian, apartment building in Atlanta; nearly 2,000 customers lose power
stories.summary: Georgia Power reported nearly 2,000 outages connected to the incident. It was not immediately clear how long power would remain out.

stories.title: 20 structures destroyed in latest count following 10-acre Gilmer County wildfire
stories.summary: An additional seven were affected and one more had minor damage, according to Gilmer County Emergency Management.

stories.title: Atlanta Hawks launch annual Black Friday, Cyber Monday ticket deals
stories.summary: This three-day sale runs from Black Friday, Nov. 27, starting at 9 a.m., to Sunday, Nov. 29, at 11:59 p.m.

stories.title: 1 dead, 1 injured after head-on collision in Rockdale County
stories.summary: This incident occurred late Sunday night.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Road closed after vehicle hit power poles causing outages in Hapeville
stories.summary: ​Hapeville Dispatch said the City is requesting barricades as repairs are expected to take about six hours.

stories.title: Atlanta Police investigating Saturday night shooting at Target parking deck near Atlantic Station
stories.summary: A 15-year-old boy faces multiple charges after a dispute led to gunfire, injuring a 17-year-old girl at Atlantic Station in Atlanta, police report.

stories.title: Gridlock Guy: Turkey Day travel tips for the road and the skies
stories.summary: “Leave early” is the advice for both drivers and flyers this holiday season, AAA says.

stories.title: Firefighter injured while battling blaze at DeKalb County complex; 9 units damaged
stories.summary: Fire crews said they encountered "heavy fire conditions," with flames extending through the roof. They said the fire had spread through the attic before crews arrive

stories.title: Saturday morning shooting leaves teenager injured, Atlanta Police say
stories.summary: ​An initial investigation revealed an additional crime scene at the 1000 block Harwell Rd NW, where multiple shell casings were recovered.

stories.title: 1 dead, 1 injured after shooting in Stone Mountain, police say
stories.summary: An initial investigation by officers suggests the men exchanged gunfire during a dispute with each other. The investigation remains active and ongoing.

stories.title: Police investigating in southwest Atlanta after man found dead at car accident scene
stories.summary: Investigators are working to determine what led up to the shooting. The investigation is active and ongoing.
